easy.def: Wanting to do something very much.
examples: I am eager to see my friends.
The dog is eager for a walk.
We were eager to open our gifts.

more.def: Very excited and interested in doing or having something.
examples: The puppies were eager to go outside and play.
The eager students raised their hands before the question ended.
He was eager to show his parents his report card.
The earthquake made the house shake.
We hid under the desk in the earthquake.
An earthquake can crack a road.

more.def: A sudden shaking of the ground caused by movement deep inside the Earth.
examples: The earthquake knocked books off the shelves.
The bridge was built to stay standing in an earthquake.
Scientists measure how strong each earthquake is.
